chapter_title: Winds of Change & Canvas of Soil
summary: Unit 3 explores India's indigenous heritage through traditional hand-fans (Pankhas) and environmental reverence. It demonstrates how utilitarian objects reflect artistic creativity and sustainable climate adaptation, alongside nature poetry that depicts the earth as a living artistic canvas.

key_takeaways: Pankhas showcase zero-carbon, eco-friendly personal cooling design.
Utilitarian household items can simultaneously serve as canvases of folk art.
Sustainable living leverages locally harvested, 100% biodegradable materials.
